name: pulso-garmin-salud
description: Panel local de salud y rendimiento con datos de Garmin: entrenador, indicadores de riesgo y explicaciones en lenguaje sencillo.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:lines
